ConnectionStrings.//DefaultConnection: Committed fallback only. Override any single part with the Database:* settings below, or replace the whole string with the ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable.

Database.//Host: Overrides the Host in the connection string above. Set with: set Database__Host=localhost
Database.//Port: The usual cause of 'connection refused' locally: Postgres often listens on a port other than 5432. Set with: set Database__Port=5433
Database.//Name: Overrides the database name. Set with: set Database__Name=AkantiDb
Database.//Username: Overrides the database user. Set with: set Database__Username=postgres
Database.//Password: Overrides the database password. Set with: set Database__Password=postgres (keep this out of version control)

ForwardedHeaders._comment: Set TrustAllProxies=true ONLY on a PaaS (Render/Fly) where the platform rewrites X-Forwarded-For. Never enable on a directly reachable host. Alternatively list exact proxy IPs in KnownProxies or CIDRs in KnownNetworks.

Email._comment: Provider: resend | brevo | sendgrid | empty (empty = SMTP, for local dev). ApiKey lives only in environment variables (Email__ApiKey).

Ai._comment: Provider: gemini | openai | groq | openrouter | anthropic. ApiKey lives only in environment variables (Ai__ApiKey) or the gitignored appsettings.Development.json. Never commit it here. With no key the assistant still answers, from the figures held in the database.
